hs-bindgen does not bind these declarations of the libmpv client API 2.5.0 headers. [`unbound.json`](unbound.json) gives each one a disposition, and `spec` and `generate` fail on a skip without one and on a disposition for a name that is bound now.

| Disposition | Skips |
| ----------- | ----: |
| `shim`      |     0 |
| `constant`  |     0 |
| `wontfix`   |     3 |
| `upstream`  |     0 |

- `shim`: a lithon-authored C shim binds it instead.
- `constant`: lithon binds its value as a typed constant (`constants.json`).
- `wontfix`: it stays unbound on purpose.
- `upstream`: it waits on an hs-bindgen fix.
